world: One continuous shot, no cuts, no fades: the camera moves smoothly and slowly the whole time, as if riding with the coffee. Soft warm daylight from the left, a plain warm cream ground above everything, the page itself. Real photographed materials: matte black metal, clear glass, clear water, real ice, real coffee, opaque deep brown, never glassy, no glow. Nothing appears from nowhere or vanishes. No hands, no people, no new text or logos.

steps.prompt: The roasted beans keep pouring down into the clear hopper of the black grinder and fill it. Then the grinder slowly comes apart in the air into its pieces like an exploded view: the hopper lifts up, the black body splits into two halves that slide out to the left and right, the steel burrs float between them turning, and fine dark coffee grounds begin to fall out of the bottom in a thin stream. The camera stays wide and still; every piece stays fully in frame.
steps.word: GRIND: the beans pouring into the grinder and the grinder opening to grind them
steps.name: K1t

steps.frame: tall phone picture: the whole grinder about a third of the frame's height a little above the middle, in front of GRIND, cream space above and below, every piece in frame
steps.end_seen: K1t-last.png looked at full size 15 Nov: the grinder taken apart under the hopper of beans, GRIND behind, and one thick stream of grounds pouring from the burrs, still attached, down to the bottom edge

steps.prompt: The thin trickle of grounds already falling from the burrs in the middle of the taken-apart grinder swells at once into a thick, heavy column of fresh coffee grounds, as wide as the burrs, one unbroken torrent that never thins, never stops and never has a gap. The thick stream of grounds already pouring from the burrs down to the bottom edge keeps pouring and never breaks or leaves the grinder. The camera tilts and glides smoothly down with the torrent, always showing it as one continuous column from the top edge of the picture down to where it lands, so it is never seen starting again. The taken-apart grinder and the word rise steadily up and out of the top of the picture while, at the same moment, the crests of a wavy ocean of clear cold water rise into view from the bottom, so the picture is never empty. There is no table, shelf, floor or edge anywhere. The ocean is a real deep ocean of rolling swells filling the lower part of the picture, never a thin sheet of water. The torrent plunges into the middle of the waves and a huge dark brown cloud of coffee billows out under the surface, spreading wider with every second until by the end it reaches both sides of the picture, the torrent still pouring into it.
steps.word: COLD: the grounds falling into the cold ocean water
steps.name: K2t

Then K2t-d.mp4 (15 Nov, made without an end still): the torrent was right but the ocean became a thin sheet of water on cream with the cloud hanging under it; it now lands on o2t.png, the same ocean as o1 with the torrent and the brown cloud reaching both sides (3aa.27). steps.prompt: The torrent of grounds thins and the last of it drops into the water within the first second; after that nothing more falls and the cream sky stays empty. The huge brown cloud keeps billowing through the water and the brown spreads swell by swell until the whole ocean from edge to edge is deep brown cold brew, the waves still rolling toward the camera, spray catching the light. Then the brown water begins to turn round the middle, slowly and then faster, into one large whirlpool in the middle of the picture, its spiral arms reaching the edges, the camera rising a little to look down into its dark funnel.
steps.word: STEEP: the grounds steeping in the water and turning it brown

steps.prompt: The large brown whirlpool keeps turning, its dark funnel deepening in the middle. The camera dives slowly down into the funnel, the spinning brown walls all round it, and comes out of the funnel's narrow bottom as one thin smooth stream of cold brew falling toward a clear glass full of clear ice below, still empty of coffee. The stream pours into the glass and the coffee rises from the bottom up through the ice, filling the glass once and staying full; it never drains or clears.
steps.word: POUR: the whirlpool pouring out as one stream into the glass of ice
